prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV (tanning beds) or a sunless spray/airbrush tan? “Best” depends on which you want and on priorities like safety, price, or a natural-looking spray tan.

If you tell me which type you want I can give more tailored tips. Meanwhile, here are quick pointers to find the best salon in Pleasanton:

How to choose
- Decide spray vs. UV: spray/airbrush (sunless) is safer and gives predictable color; UV beds increase skin cancer risk.
- Check ratings: search Google Maps and Yelp, sort by rating and read recent reviews (last 6–12 months).
- Look for credentials: spray salons using well-known systems (VersaSpa, Mystic, Norvell) or technicians who mention certification/training.
- Cleanliness and privacy: look for photos or review comments about clean booths, fresh solution, disposable hair/eye coverings.
- Ask about products and results: for spray tans ask about solution brand, color options, and whether they use airbrush or automated spray. For beds ask about bed age, maintenance, and staff guidance for first-timers.
- Pricing & packages: many salons offer first-time specials, multi-session packages, or membership discounts.
- Safety & policies: ask about skin consultations, patch tests, and COVID/cleaning protocols if that matters to you.

Questions to call/email a salon
- What type/brand of spray/tanning system do you use?
- Do you offer airbrush (technician-applied) or only automated booths?
- Are technicians certified? Do you do patch tests for first-timers?
- What are your aftercare instructions and typical results?
- Any first-time discounts or package deals?

If you want, tell me:
- Spray or UV?
- Your budget and preferred location (Pleasanton downtown, near Stoneridge, etc.)

I can then suggest what to search for or (if you’d like) provide a short list of likely top-rated salons nearby and what to check in their reviews.
